data.narrative:
Hermeus, a Series C stage developer of supersonic and hypersonic aerospace technology founded by AJ Piplica, Skyler Shuford, Glenn Case, and Mike Smayda, has raised $500M to date against a current $1.0B post-money valuation. The comparable universe in supersonic and hypersonic development is sparse: two public peers (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and one private peer (Boom Supersonic) were identified, though insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage peers precluded a reliable peer-median approach.

Stage-progression analysis, the applicable triangulation method here, applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical of Series C to Series D advancement. Applied to the $1.0B last post-money valuation, this method implies a forward valuation of $1.7B. This represents the sole quantitative anchor for the analysis given the thinness of the peer set.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $1.4B to $2.0B, with a median estimate of $1.7B. This range reflects reasonable variance around stage-progression mechanics but carries material uncertainty given the absence of sufficient comparable transactions in this specialized sector. The key limitation is the dearth of peer data; valuation confidence would meaningfully improve with additional same-stage or adjacent-stage comparable financings in supersonic and hypersonic development.
